description: Expected bytes derived by hand from the rule text at rc.5 (RC5-A); the reference engine does not yet produce them, so this vector is listed in tests/conformance/pending.json until RC5-B. AGSC-06-14 — 'Every published item MUST be reachable from /llms.txt, directly or through a listed cluster section' — is a MUST over the discovery surface that no vector cited before rc.5 (V9A-26). Derivation from the rule plus the layout of AGSC-06-13a that disc-0006 already pins: an item carrying `clusters[]` is reachable through the section of its FIRST (primary) cluster when that cluster is listed; an item carrying no cluster, and an item whose primary cluster is not listed, are reachable only through the `Other` section, so a writer that lists neither fails this rule. `sable` is clustered under an unlisted cluster and must therefore appear under `Other` beside the unclustered `loose-note`, which is the case no earlier vector covered. A `draft` item is not published (AGSC-02-23) and is neither reachable nor a fault. /llms-full.txt carries the same index plus item bodies, so the two reachability sets are identical.
